name: HashiCorp Vault
label: HashiCorp Vault HTTP API v1
description: Vault HTTP API v1 (KV v2 + Transit + token + leases) via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/api-docs. Operations: kv-get, kv-put, kv-delete, kv-list, transit-encrypt, transit-decrypt, token-lookup, renew-lease, listen. Auth secret vault_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). GET/access operations still call the official GET (or access) HTTP method. Retrieved secret material must not be logged and should stay in StudioQuack secret bindings (bind OUTPUT `data` into a secret; do not print it, persist it in engine variables, or leave it on a logged edge). listen is kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put vault_token here. Path params match api_spec.json placeholders. Example: {"operation":"kv-get"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: kv-get | kv-put | kv-delete | kv-list | transit-encrypt | transit-decrypt | token-lookup | renew-lease | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen is ingress: no HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'kv-get'.

schema.label: secretPath
schema.description: KV path relative to the mount (no data/ prefix). Required for kv-*. Nested paths are URL-encoded.

schema.label: keyName
schema.description: Transit key name for transit-encrypt / transit-decrypt.

schema.label: version
schema.description: Optional KV v2 version query for kv-get.

schema.label: lease_id
schema.description: Vault secret lease_id for renew-lease (not a token).

schema.label: plaintext
schema.description: Transit encrypt payload from a StudioQuack secret binding. Never a logged field.

schema.label: context
schema.description: Request-body parameter `context` for operations: transit-encrypt, transit-decrypt.

schema.label: nonce
schema.description: Request-body parameter `nonce` for operations: transit-encrypt, transit-decrypt.

schema.label: associated_data
schema.description: Request-body parameter `associated_data` for operations: transit-encrypt, transit-decrypt.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Secret bytes in data must not be logged; bind them into StudioQuack secrets. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON from the official API. May contain secret material — never log; bind into StudioQuack secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: kv-get, kv-put, kv-delete, kv-list, transit-encrypt, transit-decrypt, token-lookup, renew-lease, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Vault token
configurationParameters.description: Vault client token. Sent as X-Vault-Token (no prefix). StudioQuack secret binding. Never logged. Never on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Vault host
configurationParameters.description: Vault host without scheme, e.g. vault.example.com:8200. TLS only (https://).

configurationParameters.label: Namespace
configurationParameters.description: Optional Vault Enterprise / HCP namespace. Sent as X-Vault-Namespace when non-blank. HCP Dedicated often admin. Blank omits the header (OSS / root).

configurationParameters.label: KV mount
configurationParameters.description: KV secrets-engine mount (no slashes). Default secret.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget (~300s).
